items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: And then when I used to pay off, I'd pay him off. Then he'd pay them off.

ctx.x: little Sammy Hopton. Mm-hmm. But I hardly see him anymore.

He's interesting. I saw him about a monocle. You see what is happening now, that union is kind of breaking up some of them fellas now. They're getting away, because the majority of the boys in school, they're all coming in local. Little rock and roll fellas, you know what I mean? They're coming in local. This little kid used to play so much climate, I started him off. He's a music major. Leonard Eberidge. I used to use him in the brass band, young kid. Well, is he Ken does something? Is that something? Step Daddy…
You played with a lot of brass bands, I remember through the years from time to time. Different ones like the Young Tuxedo, you were with them pretty regular for a while.
